name: fixture-flow-fragment-setup-fresh-user
description: Real example flow fragment (steps only, no config document): launchApp, type/into, capture, assertApi, extract.
yaml:
# Sub-flow: provision a fresh test account before the main flow.
# Loaded via `requires:` or `runFlow:` from a parent script. Runs
# in the parent's context so any captures + extracted variables
# survive the sub-flow boundary.
- launchApp
- waitFor: "Sign up"
- tap: "Sign up"

- type:
    into:
      id: signup_email
    text: ${email}
- type:
    into:
      id: signup_password
    text: ${password}

- capture: "POST /api/v1/auth/signup as: signupRsp"
- tap: "Create account"

- assertApi:
    from: signupRsp
    status: 201
    body:
      "$.user.email": ${email}

- extract:
    from: signupRsp
    values:
      newUserId: $.user.id

- waitFor: "Welcome"
- screenshot: account-created
